item.skyabyss.star_lamp.desc: Starlight learned at the star pool. Lights your feet and draws out what hides in shadow.
item.skyabyss.star_lamp.use: Right-click: set a star mark at your feet (30 s, two at once)
item.skyabyss.star_shard.desc: A piece of a star fallen into the new-moon valley. Three open the gate of the mesa.
item.skyabyss.moon_dust.desc: Fine pale-blue dust caked on a dust crawler's shell.
item.skyabyss.crescent_shell.desc: The crescent-shaped plate from a shell hare's back. Its rim shines silver.
item.skyabyss.shadow_thread.desc: A thread of starlight that pinned a shadow stitcher's bands together.
message.skyabyss.moon.lamp_post.need_lam: The lamp post is cold. Without a star lamp, it will not light.
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.learn: Starlight lingers on your fingertips. You learned the star lamp. (Hold it and right-click to set a star mark at your feet.)
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.again: The star pool ripples faintly. The lamp is already in your hand.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.bridge: You took the star shard from the pedestal on the pillar.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.mirror: The light of three mirrors gathers on the pedestal, and a star shard rises.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.hole: At the bottom of the fallen star you pick up a shard. It is still faintly warm.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.mirror_dark: The pedestal stays dark. The mirrors are not turned the same way.
message.skyabyss.moon.shard.hole_guarded: The shell hares guard their nest. Drive them off before you can reach the pedestal.
message.skyabyss.moon.gate_star.sealed: The star gate is closed. The traveller at the camp may know about the valley.
message.skyabyss.moon.gate_star.need_sha: The star gate hums faintly. Not enough shards yet.
message.skyabyss.moon.chasm_fall: You fell into the bottomless dark... and woke beside the camp light.
message.skyabyss.moon.lord_down: The embraced shadow comes undone, and starlight returns to the mesa.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.title: The New-Moon Valley
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.summary: South of the moon landing a valley runs down. In the lee of its entrance, a camp light burns.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.done: You defeated the shadow embracer and made a promise to your past self. You will meet again at the moon's heart.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.meet.jou: A camp light burns where the valley descends south of the landing. Talk to the hooded traveller beside it.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.meet.tal: Talk to the traveller at the camp
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.pool.jou: Dip your hand in the star pool at the back of the camp and learn starlight.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.shards.j: Gather three star shards fallen in the valley: the shadow bridge over the western chasm, the mirror hollow in the east, the fallen star's pit in the south.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.shards.b: Shard on the shadow bridge pillar
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.shards.h: Shard in the fallen star's pit
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.gate.jou: The shards are gathered. Climb to the lord's hollow through the star gate at the north foot of the mesa.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_valley.lord.jou: Light the lamp posts of the hollow with your star lamp, draw the shadow embracer into the light and defeat it.
Return to the traveller at the camp.
Talk to the traveller at the camp
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past1.ch6_v:
...You came. You followed the camp light, didn't you?
When I first came here, I followed the same light. ...I never knew who had lit it.
Sit. On the moon, hurrying won't bring the dawn.
Who are you?
What is this valley?

Any name I could give is under the dust now.
What I remember is walking this valley again and again. And stopping, again and again, on top of that mesa.

A lord of shadow waits on the mesa. In the dark, no blade gets through.
Dip your hand in the star pool at the back. Learn starlight, and you can draw the shadow out.
Go to the star pool

The star pool is the purple bowl at the back of the camp.
Dip your hand, and a star lamp stays with you. Light your feet with it.
Understood
Three star shards fell in this valley. With all three, the mesa gate opens.
Which do you want to hear about?
The shadow bridge
The mirror hollow
The fallen star's pit
I'm going

Over the western chasm there's a bridge that exists only in the dark. Light it and it's gone.
The shard is on the pillar in the middle. ...Set your lamp once you're across. The stitchers wait on the bridge.

In the white hollow to the east stand three mirror stones.
Turn all three to face the middle, and starlight gathers on the pedestal. ...They are always a little off.

A star fell into the southern pit. Shell hares nest there.
They leap high and come down on you. When a ring of shadow appears at your feet, step out of it. Drive off the nest and you can reach the pedestal at the bottom.

You have all three. At the north foot of the mesa is the star gate.
Through it lies the lord's hollow, with six lamp posts. ...Light them with your lamp and draw the shadow into them.
I'm going
The embracer never lets go of the shadow it holds. While it stays in the dark, no blade gets through.

Draw it into the light and it freezes for a moment. Strike then.
...Last time, I spent all my light here. Don't hurry your lamps.
Understood
...You beat it. I saw the shadow on the mesa come undone.

I remembered something. On the last night, the moon fell.
I couldn't stop it. Time wound back, and I was standing at the valley's mouth again. ...I've stopped counting how many times.

At the moon's heart there is a core that turns time back. Let's meet there.
This time, we stop it together. ...I'll leave this light with you.
I promise
On the moon, hurrying won't bring the dawn. ...Rest a while.
I'll be back
chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.chapter3: The valley's shadow has come undone. The moon's center is still far.
message.skyabyss.moon_end.todo: The journey on the moon reaches an ending here. The final chapter, "Sea of Clouds", continues in the next version.
item.skyabyss.moon_weight.desc: A weight for the near plate of the balance rock. Returns to its pile when you leave the cliffs.
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.light_body: As your hand touches the moon pool, your body turns light. You learned the star art Light Body. (Press jump again in mid-air to leap once more)
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.light_body_ag: The moon pool ripples quietly. Your body is still light.
message.skyabyss.moon.cliff_shard.tower: From the pedestal atop the spiral, you take up a star shard.
message.skyabyss.moon.cliff_shard.ledge: You made it across the crumbling ledge. From the pedestal on the pillar, you take up a star shard.
message.skyabyss.moon.cliff_shard.balanc: From the pedestal on the tall pillar, you take up a star shard. Below, the balance plates slowly settle.
message.skyabyss.moon.cliff_gate.sealed: The summit gate is shut. ...The climber at the camp seems to know this cliff.
message.skyabyss.moon.cliff_gate.need_sh: The summit gate hums faintly. ...You don't have enough shards yet.
message.skyabyss.moon.plate_fall: You slid off the plate's edge... and came to at the plate's entrance.
message.skyabyss.moon.scale_topple: The plate sinks on your side and lifts the Scale's side. The Moon Scale falls to its knees. Now!
message.skyabyss.moon.scale_down: The Moon Scale crumbles, and the summit plate slowly levels out.
message.skyabyss.moon.weight.full: You can't carry more weights. (Two at most)
message.skyabyss.moon.weight.pick: You pick up a moon weight. (Right-click the near plate to set it down)
message.skyabyss.moon.weight.where: Weights go on the near plate, the one by the path.
message.skyabyss.moon.weight.plate_full: There's no room left on the plate for another weight.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_cliff.title: The Waxing Cliffs
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_cliff.summary: East of the landing, a ridge climbs in the shape of a waxing moon. In the lee of its foot, a camp light burns.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_cliff.done: You felled the Moon Scale and made a promise with the visored climber. You will meet again at the moon's heart.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_cliff.meet.jour: At the foot of the ridge east of the landing there's a camp light. Talk to the climber with the visored face.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_cliff.pool.jour: Dip your hand in the moon pool at the back of the camp and learn the star art Light Body.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_cliff.shards.jo: Gather the three star shards on the cliffs: atop the leaping-stone spire, on the pillar past the crumbling ledge, and on the tall pillar beyond the balance.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_cliff.gate.jour: You have the shards. Go up through the summit gate at the path's end, onto the Scale's plate.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_cliff.lord.jour: Make the Moon Scale's weights fall on your side of the plate, and strike when it topples. When the plate tilts, get to the high side.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past2.ch6_c:
...Come to climb again? No, this is your first time.
As for me, I've lost count.
Sit. The cliff isn't going anywhere. It's only the fallen who keep coming back.
Who are you?
What is this cliff?

I left my name at the bottom of the cliff.
What I remember is falling from this cliff, over and over. And stopping, over and over, on the plate at the summit.

You cross this cliff by leaping. But there are places a plain jump won't reach.
Dip your hand in the moon pool at the back of the camp. Learn Light Body, and you can leap again in mid-air.
Go to the moon pool

The moon pool is the purple bowl at the back of the camp.
Dip your hand and your body grows light. In mid-air, press jump once more.
Understood
There are three star shards on the cliff. With all three, the summit gate opens.
Which do you want to hear about?
The leaping-stone spire
The crumbling ledge
The balance rock
I'm going

Inside the path, floating stones stand in a spiral. Each one is higher than a plain jump can reach.
Leap again in mid-air. The shard is on the pedestal at the top. ...A fall won't kill you. You just start over from below.

Partway along the path, a narrow ledge runs out along a fin of rock. It crumbles under you.
Don't stop. The shard is on the pillar at the far end. ...I stopped there more times than I can count.

Just short of the summit hang two balance plates. Weigh down the near one, and the far one rises. The weights are in a pile beside the path.
When the far plate is all the way up, leap to the tall pillar. Two weights will lift it all the way.

You have all three. At the end of the path is the summit gate.
Beyond it is the Moon Scale's plate. ...Want to hear about it?
I'm going
The Moon Scale stands on its balance. Strike it, and it barely notices.

Let the weights it throws land on your side of the plate. When two are down, its side lifts and it topples. Strike then.
...When the plate tilts, leap to the high side. Slide to the edge and you're back at the entrance.
Understood
...You beat it. I saw the summit plate level out again.

I remember now. On the last night, I stood on that plate looking up at the moon.
The moon came down. Alone, I couldn't stop it. ...And then I was at the foot of the cliff again.

At the moon's heart, another one of me should be waiting.
This time, we stop it together. ...I'll leave this rope with you.
I promise
I'm used to falling by now. ...Not that it's anything to get used to.
I'll be back
message.skyabyss.moon.plate_barred: An unseen force pushes you back. ...Go up to the summit plate through the summit gate.
item.skyabyss.moon_hourglass.desc: An hourglass whose moon sand never runs out. Given at the moon pool of the Full-Moon Fields
item.skyabyss.moon_hourglass.use: Right-click: stops nearby foes, projectiles and tide stones for 2 seconds (on the moon, once every 12 seconds)
item.skyabyss.full_keeper_spawn_egg: Keeper of the Full Moon Spawn Egg
message.skyabyss.moon.moment_stop.not_mo: The sand will not fall here. ...Time only stops on the moon, it seems.
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.moment_stop: You lift an hourglass from the bottom of the moon pool. Turning it over, every sound around you falls silent. You learned the star art Moment Stop. (Right-click the Moon Hourglass)
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.moment_stop_a: The moon pool brightens and dims quietly with the tide.
message.skyabyss.moon.field_shard.pond: You take the star shard from the pedestal on the pond's pillar. The stones underfoot fade again.
message.skyabyss.moon.field_shard.gully: You made it through the falling light. You take the star shard from the pedestal under the overhang.
message.skyabyss.moon.field_shard.tower: You take the star shard from the top of the Shade Tower. The white mesa in the middle of the fields is clear from here.
message.skyabyss.moon.field_gate.sealed: The Full-Moon Gate is shut. ...The counter at the camp seems to know these fields.
message.skyabyss.moon.field_gate.need_sh: The Full-Moon Gate hums faintly. ...Not enough shards yet.
message.skyabyss.moon.pond_fall: You fell toward the light at the bottom of the pond... and found yourself back on the rock ledge at its rim.
message.skyabyss.moon.mesa_fall: You fell from the edge of the mesa... and found yourself back at the entrance of the arena.
message.skyabyss.moon.mesa_barred: An unseen force pushed you back. ...Climb the Full-Moon Mesa through the gate at its foot.
message.skyabyss.moon.keeper_kneel: The light of the swollen orb crumbles inside the stopped moment. The Keeper kneels. Now!
message.skyabyss.moon.keeper_shade: The wave of light burned you. ...Behind the shade pillars that rise at ebb tide, the light cannot reach.
message.skyabyss.moon.keeper_down: The light in the Keeper's orb goes out, and the tide over the fields slowly calms.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.title: The Full-Moon Fields
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.summary: West of the landing, fields of white sand spread out. The light swells and ebbs. At their eastern edge, a fallen monolith and a camp's glow.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.done: You defeated the Keeper of the Full Moon and made a promise with the Hourglass Counter. You will meet again at the heart of the moon.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.meet.jour: At the eastern edge of the fields west of the landing, a camp sits in the lee of a fallen monolith. Talk to the one with the blindfold.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.pool.jour: Touch the moon pool at the camp and learn the star art Moment Stop.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.shards.jo: Gather the three star shards fallen on the fields: the Tide Pond to the north, the Gully of Falling Light to the south, the Shade Tower to the west.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.shards.gu: Shard of the Gully of Falling Light
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.gate.jour: The shards are complete. Climb through the Full-Moon Gate at the eastern foot of the white mesa in the middle of the fields.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.lord.jour: The Keeper gathers light while the tide is bright and releases it as it turns to ebb. Hide behind the shade pillars, or break it with Moment Stop before it fires.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_field.lord.defe: Defeat the Keeper of the Full Moon
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past3.ch6_f:
...Two hundred and eleven. No, twelve.
I was counting the tides. With my eyes closed, I can hear the light swell.
So you've come. A me from a little before the one on the cliff.
Who are you?
Your eyes?

My name is under the sand now. The eyes, I covered myself.
In these fields, what you see is the least reliable thing. Light stones are there only at swell, shade stones only at ebb.

At the turn, both kinds fade. The ground vanishes beneath you.
So I learned to stop time. An hourglass lies at the bottom of the moon pool at the camp. Go and pick it up.
Go to the moon pool

Turn the hourglass from the moon pool and time around you stops for a moment.
Foes, falling light, the stones underfoot. ...Only for a moment, mind you.
Understood
Three star shards lie in these fields. With all three, the gate of the white mesa in the middle opens.
Which would you hear about?
The Tide Pond
The Gully of Falling Light
The Shade Tower
I'll go

The pond to the north is too deep to see the bottom. Light stones and shade stones spiral across it to a pillar.
When you change from light to shade, the ground vanishes for the two seconds of the turn. Turn the hourglass before it does.

Light keeps falling into the gully to the south. Where it will land glows first. When it glows, step away.
The nooks in the north wall get a roof of shade only at ebb. ...And falling light, once stopped, is just a lamp.

The tower to the west was built by pilgrims before me. Inside, the lower steps are shade stone and the upper ones light stone.
Climb the shade steps at ebb, and outlast the two-second turn to swell inside a stopped moment. ...The fields look lovely from the top.

All three, then. The Full-Moon Gate is at the eastern foot of the white mesa.
The Keeper waits above. ...Will you hear about it?
I'll go
The Keeper gathers light into the orb in its chest while the tide is bright. While it gathers, blades barely bite.

As the tide turns to ebb, it releases what it gathered. The shade pillars on the mesa rise only at ebb. Get behind them.
Or... stop time while the orb swells, before it fires. The light crumbles and the Keeper kneels.
Understood
...The tide has gone quiet. You beat it.

I remember now. That night, on the mesa, I stopped time. The moment the moon came down.
I could hold it only for a moment. When the sand ran out, the moon kept falling.

A moment is not enough. But if we join our moments together, it might reach.
Let's meet again at the heart of the moon. ...I think I'll stop counting now.
I promise
Swell, turn, ebb, turn. ...I don't need to count anymore. My body remembers.
I'll be back
message.skyabyss.moon.echo.recording: The mirror ripples pale blue. For 8 seconds it remembers how you move. (Touch it again to stop early.)
message.skyabyss.moon.echo.stored: The mirror remembers. Your afterimage waits inside. Touch the mirror and it will trace what it saw.
message.skyabyss.moon.echo.stored_fall: The mirror kept your moves from before the fall. Your afterimage waits inside.
message.skyabyss.moon.pool.rift: You dip your hand in the moon pool. Starlight, Light Body and Moment Stop all come back to your fingertips. The rift needs all three.
message.skyabyss.moon.rift_shard.door: You take the star shard from the dais behind the bars. Out on the ledge, your afterimage is still standing.
message.skyabyss.moon.rift_shard.leap: You take the star shard from the island dais. Across the rift, your frozen self comes apart.
message.skyabyss.moon.rift_shard.hall: You take the star shard at the end of the gallery. The remnant pools sink quietly.
message.skyabyss.moon.rift_gate.sealed: The Waning Gate is shut. The copier at the camp may know about the rift.
message.skyabyss.moon.rift_gate.need_sha: The Waning Gate hums faintly. Not enough shards yet.
message.skyabyss.moon.rift_fall: You fell into the dark of the rift... and found yourself back at the edge.
message.skyabyss.moon.rift_barred: Something unseen pushed you back the moment you touched the pillar floor. You must go down through the gate on the rim.
message.skyabyss.moon.blade_stagger: The afterimage's blade cut the Waning Blade itself. It drops to one knee. Now!
message.skyabyss.moon.blade_waning: The east edge of the floor crumbles away. Your self from three seconds ago stands behind you. Don't touch it.
message.skyabyss.moon.blade_down: The Waning Blade sinks to its knees and its afterimage unravels. Wind rises from the bottom of the rift.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_rift.title: The Waning Rift
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_rift.summary: Southeast of the landing, the ground splits wide in the shape of a waning moon. A camp light glows on the dark plateau inside.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_rift.done: You defeated the Waning Blade and made a promise with the Mirror Copier. The fourth of you will be at the heart of the moon too.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_rift.meet.journ: Inside the rift southeast of the landing, a camp sits on the west of the dark plateau. Talk to the half-faded figure.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_rift.pool.journ: Touch the moon pool at the camp to recall your three star arts.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_rift.shards.jou: Gather three star shards in the rift: the two-plate gate to the north, the afterimage leap to the southeast, the lamp gallery to the southwest. Use your afterimage from the Waning Mirrors.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_rift.gate.journ: The shards are complete. Go down to the boss hall through the Waning Gate on the east rim.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_rift.lord.journ: The Waning Blade's afterimage follows three seconds behind it. Lure the Blade into the path of its afterimage's strikes and it will be cut down by its own past.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past4.ch6_r:
...Ah. At last, a me who isn't an afterimage.
I've been talking to myself in the mirror. The answers always come three seconds late.

Don't be startled. I'm the oldest of you.
Older than the one in the valley, the one on the cliff, the one in the field.
Who are you?
You're see-through

Every rewind wore me thinner. By now I'm half afterimage myself.
In this rift, the seconds that pass take shape and rise again. The foes you fell, and you yourself.

There's nothing to fear. Your past self can be put to use.
Go to the moon pool at the camp first, and call the three arts you've learned back to your hands.
Go to the moon pool

Starlight, Light Body, Moment Stop. The rift needs all three.
Then touch the mirror there. It remembers you for 8 seconds. Touch it again and your afterimage steps out.
Understood
There are three star shards in the rift. With all three, the Waning Gate on the east rim opens.
Which do you want to hear about?
The Waning Mirror
The two-plate gate
The afterimage leap
The lamp gallery
I'll go

Touch the mirror and it starts remembering; after 8 seconds, or when you touch it again, it stops. The afterimage waits inside.
Touch it once more and the afterimage moves just as you did. You can stand on its head. It presses plates. ...Starlight makes it vanish, though.

The north gate opens only while both plates are pressed at once. They're far apart.
One person isn't enough. ...But you aren't alone. Let the mirror remember you walking to the far plate.

Even Light Body won't reach the southeast island. I fell more times than I can count.
Have the mirror remember you leaping out, and stop time while your afterimage is in the air. Your frozen self's head becomes one more foothold.

Along the southwest gallery are remnant pools. Come close and the afterimages of old pilgrims rise.
Light them and nothing rises. But light also melts the shadow bridges under your feet. Choose carefully where to shine.
You have all three. The Waning Gate is on the east rim. The Blade waits on the pillar below.
I'll go
The Blade fights alongside its own afterimage. The afterimage repeats its moves three seconds later, in the same place.

The afterimage's blade cuts the Blade itself. Lure it to where it stood three seconds ago.
Stopping time won't stop the afterimage. A strike from three seconds ago will reach the frozen Blade.
Understood
...The wind in the rift has changed. You defeated it.

I remember now. The very first night.
When the moon fell, I held up my mirror. I showed the moon's core my reflection. The core remembered me, and turned time back. ...Maybe that was how it all began.

All four of us are here. The valley me, the cliff me, the field me, and me.
Let's meet at the heart of the moon. Not to turn it back this time, but to end it.
I promise
The me in the mirror always nods three seconds late. ...You nod right on time.
I'll come again
message.skyabyss.moon.core_gate.sealed: The blackstone gate is cold and shut. Promises remain, as far as the rift.
message.skyabyss.moon.core_gate.gather: Four shadows stand around the gate: the valley me, the cliff me, the field me, the rift me. Touch the gate again to go down to the core.
message.skyabyss.moon.core_shield: A moon shard turned your blade aside. Strike through the gaps between the shards.
message.skyabyss.moon.core_rewind: Two shards shattered. A clock ring floats around the core. Cut it down before the ring closes, or time turns back.
message.skyabyss.moon.core_break: The clock ring shattered. The rewind breaks and the core stalls. Now!
message.skyabyss.moon.core_allies: The last shards shatter. On the four daises stand four of you. "The full moon is coming. Stay by us."
message.skyabyss.moon.core_drop: The shadow of the full moon swells overhead. The floor turns red. Get to the blue circles beside the four.
message.skyabyss.moon.core_ally_stop: The field me turns the hourglass. The core stops for a moment.
message.skyabyss.moon.core_down: The core's eye closes and its three rings fall still. Something inside the moon is coming undone.
message.skyabyss.moon.core_fall: You fell into the dark of the core chamber... and found yourself back at the floor's edge.
message.skyabyss.moon.core_barred: An unseen hand pushed you back. The only way into the core chamber is the gate north of the landing.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.title: The Moon's Core
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.summary: You made promises with four of yourself. North of the landing, a blackstone gate stands open. At the heart of the moon waits the core that binds time.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.done: You stopped the moon's core. The rewinding is over and the four of you returned to the light. ...And still the moon falls.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.gather.jou: Go to the blackstone gate north of the landing and touch it. Four of you are waiting.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.gather.gat: Meet the four at the core gate
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.descend.jo: Touch the core gate again and go down to the chamber inside the moon.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.descend.cr: Go down to the core chamber
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.core.journ: Stop the moon's core. Strike between the shards, cut it down before the clock ring closes, and when the full moon falls, stand by the four.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_core.end.journa: The core has stopped. ...What is happening on the moon?
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past1.ch6_c:
I brought my lamp. The core chamber is dark.
...A light kept by four is so much brighter than one kept alone.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past2.ch6_c:
We won't need my rope to go down. The gate takes us.
If we fall, we climb again. This time there's somewhere to climb to.
Let's go
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past3.ch6_c:
I stopped counting. But I'll count this one moment.
...One. Before the core, I'll stop time for you.
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_moon_past4.ch6_c:
The core still remembers the reflection I showed it. This time, let it see all four of us.
When the full moon falls, come to us. Its light can't reach the ground around the four of us.
